upstream.observation: fs/readFile uses absolute path and base64 file bytes. This does not establish mobile293 call wiring or authorization.

host_gap: Synchronous local file materialization has no loading/cancel/retry state. Missing full-file snapshots silently omit Open file.
decision: Retain source-observed openFile action, add an explicitly independent scoped asynchronous resource adapter and loading/error/cancel UI. No filesystem RPC or backend implemented.
unknowns: Exact loading/error UI and absent-resource visibility
Diff gutters/comments/line colors and precise layout

coverage: failure then retry, cancel then reopen
complete file and native close return

visual.scope: Chinese light and English dark failure UI, full file preview, unavailable resource; exact official parity remains partial

official_observations.finding: browserState resolves to WorkspaceBrowserViewModel.RenderState; actionHandler resolves to Handler<WorkspaceBrowserViewAction>.
Metadata contains openingFileID, rootDirectoryState, searchState, visibleEntries and isAllFilesAvailable. Values and presentation policy remain unknown.
Cases include entryTapped, linkTurnDiffFileToChatTapped, viewAppeared/viewDisappeared and retryRootDirectoryTapped. Directory retry does not establish file-open retry presentation.

adapter_contract.input: Immutable full-file snapshot plus RemoteComposerDraftScope and fresh request UUID
adapter_contract.result: Complete UTF-8 contents or typed unavailable/loadFailed/unsupported outcome
adapter_contract.identity: Host/thread, file ID, unique attempt ID. Snapshot/view changes cancel active attempt. Account/profile lifetime remains owned by the existing page/history store.
adapter_contract.cancellation: Local dismissal and cancel invalidate before accepting another result. Provider CancellationError also exits loading only if its request is current.
adapter_contract.resource_lifetime: Existing RemoteLocalAttachment owns the temporary file through QuickLook; it is released when preview URL clears.
adapter_contract.backend: Only offline snapshot implementation is supplied. Actual resource lookup, authentication and transport remain future adapters.

remaining_limits: The state reducer directly verifies stale and duplicate callbacks. UI uses cancellation-aware synthetic delay; it does not prove a real transport stops remote work.
Official action owner/branch and exact loading/error layout are unverified.
Current complete-file adapter handles supplied UTF-8 text; other file types continue through existing attachment previews.
iteration_history: r1 three UI cases passed with initial fixture injection
r2 three UI cases passed with injection moved to loader actor
r3 final provider cancellation handling and complete three-case regression
cross_platform: iOS293 evidence only. Resource request/state isolation is independent frontend logic; Android native file/browser owner and visual behavior require separate evidence and runtime acceptance.
